svg.text: PR #1881 · Freeze NATIVE_1M_MODELS as legacy-fallback data; drop its maintenance obligation
The hand-copied native-1M table was to be deleted when an SDK capability shipped; the wire
now carries the CLI's own resolved window, so the table freezes as legacy fallback instead.
